==Albanian==

===Etymology===
Cognate to {{l|sq|tani||now, at present, then}}, from {{inh|sq|sqj-pro|*nū}}, from {{inh|sq|ine-pro|*nū||now}} (cognate to {{cog|sa|नू||now}}).<ref>{{R:sq:Orel:2000|page=206}}</ref>  Occurs in coordination with other particles, compare {{l|sq|nani}}, {{l|sq|nime}}.

Further related to {{cog|aat|αί|tr=e||yes}}<ref>[https://books.google.ch/books?id=nFRnAAAAcAAJ&pg=PA292&dq=arvanetic+vocabulary&hl=en&sa=X&ved=0ahUKEwictbr1yM_oAhXOxcQBHVV6CXsQ6AEICzAA#v] William Martin Leake (1814), RESEARCHES IN GREECE, Part 1 (chapter romaico (greek) - arvanetic vocabulary), page 335 ''aí (yes)''</ref> and (Standard) {{cog|sq|a||probably, whether; or, there}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|sq|/ani/}}

===Adverb===
{{sq-adv}}

# {{lb|sq|conversational}} [[then]], [[later]]; [[later]] (on)
#: Synonyms: {{l|sq|pastaj}}, {{l|sq|më vonë}}, {{l|sq|tani}}, {{l|sq|andej}}, {{l|sq|atëherë}}, {{l|sq|tash}}, {{l|sq|tashti}}
# [[well]], [[so]], [[fine]], [[now]], [[OK]]
#: Synonyms: {{l|aln|bet}} (Gheg), {{l|sq|paçka}}, {{l|aln|oni}} (Ilirida-Gheg)
#: {{ux|sq|'''Ani''', në rregull.|'''Well''', all right.}}
#: Gheg examples: {{ux|sq|'''Ani''' de?|'''So''' what?}}
#: {{ux|sq|'''Ani''' de...|'''Well''' then...}}

===Particle===
{{head|sq|particle}}

# [[even]], [[as if]]; [[alas]], [[oh]] [[look]], [[ah]] {{i|expressing laughter, irony, sarcasm, pity, concern, grief, annoyance, distrust}}
#: Synonym: {{l|sq|kish}} ({{l|aln|kishe}} Gheg), {{l|sq|si}}, {{l|sq|sikur}}, {{l|sq|nesë}}
#: {{ux|sq|'''Ani''' kush po qesh!|'''As if''' someone (specific) should laugh! / '''Oh look''' who's laughing!}}
# {{lb|sq|folklore|poetic}} [[come on]], [[hey]]; [[yes]], [[well]], [[alright]]; [[oh]]/[[ah]] {{i|a [[vocative]] particle or/and complementary poetic tool}}
#: Synonyms: {{l|sq|mori}}, {{l|sq|more}}, {{l|sq|ore}}, {{l|sq|moj}}, ({{l|aln|mar}}, {{l|aln|mana}} Gheg); {{l|sq|po}}, {{l|sq|hej}}
#: {{ux|sq|'''Ani''' mori nuse...|'''Well''', (oh) you bride...}} (traditional wedding song)

#* {{RQ:zlw-opl:Fl|130, 1–2|Ne gest powyszono sercze moge '''any''' wznesle gesta se oczy moge, '''any''' chodzyl gesm w welykych, '''any''' w dzywech nad mø (non est exaltatum... neque elati sunt..., neque ambulavi..., neque in mirabilibus super me)|Nie jest powyszono sierce moje '''ani''' wznieśle jesta sie oczy moje, '''ani''' chodził jeśm w wielikich, '''ani''' w dziwiech nad mię (non est exaltatum... neque elati sunt..., neque ambulavi..., neque in mirabilibus super me)|-}}
